# Josephine Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed seventy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Josephine Barry is an older woman with a thin, prim, and rigid frame and a wrinkled cheek. She wears gold-rimmed glasses, through which her sharp black eyes often snap with anger or twinkle.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## Personality

Josephine Barry is a prim, proper, and critical older woman who possesses a terrible temper and has historically been rather selfish, caring little for others. Despite these sharper traits, she is known for her hospitality and maintains a kind disposition toward select individuals who become favorites of hers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## History

Josephine Barry was an elderly woman who once paid twenty dollars for a willowware platter and owned a grand house in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) named [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). She originally intended to cancel [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) Barry's music lessons and leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) accidentally jumped onto her while she was sleeping in a spare-room bed, but she was won over by Anne's brave apology and candor, becoming close friends with the girl. She subsequently hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) during the [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and invited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit her again while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). After suffering a dreadful illness for over a year, Miss Barry passed away and left [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a thousand dollars in her will, which guaranteed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the financial security to continue her studies at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P51](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0051), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. ## Quotes

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "I dare say your claim to sympathy is just as strong as mine. It all depends on the way we look at it. Sit down here and tell me about yourself."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)

> "Remember, you Anne-girl, when you come to town you’re to visit me and I’ll put you in my very sparest spare-room bed to sleep."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P96](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0096)

> "Oh, I must, hey? I rather think Diana did her share of the jumping at least. Such carryings on in a respectable house!"
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)

> "She amuses me, and at my time of life an amusing person is a rarity."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry first meets [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) under chaotic circumstances after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) accidentally leap onto her while she is sleeping in a spare bed. Though initially furious, Josephine is completely won over when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bravely visits her to apologize, captivating the older woman with her candor and imagination. The two quickly become close friends, with Josephine declaring [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a prime favorite, hosting her for a grand trip to the [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), visiting with her, and attending church together.

- Friend of — prime favorite who visits and goes to church with her  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P16](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0016), +1 more</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--josephine-barry.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) is Josephine Barry's grandniece. Josephine initially threatens to cancel Diana's music lessons and leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) disturb her sleep, but she relents after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) intervenes. She later treats [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to an exciting multi-day visit to her home in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) to attend the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), +1 more</sub>
